Glossary · Banking and bonds

Home loan होम लोन

A long-term loan to buy or build a home, secured against the property and repaid through EMIs.

हिंदी में: होम लोन

घर ख़रीदने या बनाने के लिए लंबी अवधि का लोन, जिसकी ज़मानत वही संपत्ति होती है और जो EMI से चुकाया जाता है।

How it is used in the lessons

The new regime has lower slab rates but allows few deductions; the old regime allows deductions such as those for PPF, EPF, ELSS, life insurance premiums, health insurance and home loan interest.
